reading: Table 4.2, PDF pages 207 to 208 (printed pages 196 to 197), describes the first Root Cause of Variances and Planned Corrective or Preventive Action as schedule variances and the second pair as cost variances; the first copy of each is the schedule one and the second the cost one.
notes: The title block has two lines: Project Title with Date Prepared, then Project Manager with Sponsor. Root Cause of Variances and Planned Corrective or Preventive Action each print twice with identical wording. The form does not say which variance each copy covers; Table 4.2 describes the first pair (pages 1 and 2) as schedule variances, work not accomplished as scheduled, and the second pair (pages 2 and 3) as cost variances, expenditure over or under plan, which also matches where each copy sits (after the accomplishment boxes, then after Funds Spent This Reporting Period). The accomplishment boxes print numbered lines: 1 to 6 for Accomplishments for This Reporting Period, 1 to 4 for Accomplishments Planned but Not Completed This Reporting Period, 1 to 4 for Accomplishments Planned for Next Reporting Period. New Risks Identified and Issues are headings over a bordered box whose top cell prints Risk: (or Issue:) with 1 tall blank row below it (one blank cell, PDF page 212, printed page 201). The prose table (Table 4.2) has no Project Manager or Sponsor element and names the second root cause Root cause of variance (singular); the blank form prints Root Cause of Variances both times, and the blank form wins.
